research_today: Follow-the-open on real 0DTE option prices (journal/research/OPENDRIVE.md). The rule is your sleeves': at 10:00 follow the move from the open, strike ~0.7% OTM, sell at 3x or at 15:30. SPY/QQQ/NVDA/TSLA from 2024-02, 1,325 trades, 10% costs. Per trade: all days -18% over the last 3 months and -27% over the full period; puts -33% over the last 3 months. Macro days (CPI/NFP/FOMC) are the worst bucket: -46% over the full period (191 trades) and -76% over the last 3 months (25 trades).

Days like today (macro day + gap down + below the open at 10:00): 41 trades, 32% win, -7% per trade, -13% without the best. The wins cluster on a few crash days (2025-04-04 and 04-10 tariffs, 2026-06-05 NFP). On SPY this setup occurs about every 2 months, and 3 of 12 reached 3x.

The only bucket positive without its best two trades: NVDA gap down + below the open at 10:00, put: 39 trades, +20% / +13% / +6%; last 3 months 9 trades +63%. It is not positive on SPY (-22%), QQQ (-12%) or TSLA (-28%). We added it as a shadow variant (nvda_gapdown_put) and did not take it to real money.

Your CPI study (3x hits 25-32% on CPI days vs 20-23% on other days) and ours ('macro days worst') can both be true. We include NFP and FOMC days, and a direction picked at 10:00 that reverses after the release is the usual loser. A 3x needs a hit rate above 33% to break even, so 25-32% still loses.
